scripts.build: npm run build -w @vault/shared && npm run build -w @vault/functions && npm run build -w @vault/web
scripts.emulators: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @vault/functions && firebase emulators:start
scripts.test:rules: echo "(no rules tests yet — added in Milestone 4)" && exit 0
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vault/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vault/functions && npm run typecheck -w @vault/web
scripts.emulators:persist: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @vault/functions && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.emulator-data',{recursive:true})" && firebase emulators:start --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit=./.emulator-data
